card.name: Letters or spaces right after digits
card.fires_on: A single letter, or a thin space inside a number, directly after a digit, as in enzyme or receptor names (1A2, 2B6, S1P) and thousands separators (70 000).

modes.label: Letter after digit in names
modes.description: A capital letter follows a digit inside a receptor, enzyme or transporter name.

modes.label: Space inside a number
modes.description: A space used as a thousands separator or before a unit exponent after digits.

card.plain: It fires on the small break right after a digit, such as the letter in CYP1A2 or the gap in 70 000.
